sections.name: Verse 1
lines: There'll be no night in heaven,
No anxious toil, no weary hours;

sections.name: Refrain
lines: In heaven above, where all is love,

sections.name: Verse 2
lines: There'll be no grief in heaven;
For life is one glad day,
And tears are those of former things

sections.name: Verse 3
lines: There'll be no sin in heaven;
All holy in there spotless robes,
